notes: Method: official issuer pages opened in a real browser on 2026-11-05 (innovationisrael.org.il and gov.il block plain HTTP fetches with 403; sba.org.il opened fine). The Innovation Authority 'open for submission' list and program pages were read in full; dates shown are the 'next submission date' the site printed that day. Grade A here means the issuing government body's own page (no filing/register exists for grants); B = dated press; C = vendor's own site (cloud-credit programmes, global, not Israeli-specific). Pages rarely print a date, so source_date is null with a note. Limits: the session's WebSearch budget ran out mid-research (so tax incentives such as accelerated depreciation, Israel Export Institute digital programmes, Negev/Galilee local programmes and the Ministry of Economy productivity grants were not verified and are listed as 'unverified' in rejected); the Hazenek/R&D programmes are startup- and manufacturing-R&D-oriented, not SME digital-adoption grants – the only live SME digital/AI grant found (SBA computerization 35% up to ₪350k) closed 2026-08-25 and recurs. Press said it was open on 2026-07-29 while the official page says closed – the official page wins.
